checkpoints.step: Unlike APPR (province-based) and ASL (fixed 1,460 days), EU limitation
checkpoints.expected: varies by DEPARTING COUNTRY: - Belgium: 365 days (1 year) ? SHORTEST in EU - Italy: 730 days (2 years) - Portugal: 1,095 days (3 years) - Germany: 1,460 days (4 years) - France/Spain: 1,825 days (5 years) - UK/Ireland: 2,190 days (6 years) - Sweden/Czech Republic: 3,650 days (10 years) ? LONGEST in EU This test uses Belgium (365 days) because it's the shortest limitation period, making it easy to demonstrate expiry. NOTE: If the departing country is NOT in the EU limitation table, eu_expiration_date is set to null and the case must be escalated for manual review. DDS RESPONSE CODE = SoC-EU-NE-08
